arguments.command: pkill -f "flutter run -d linux" || true; rm -f /tmp/flutter_run_testbg.log /tmp/flutter_bgpid_tmp; nohup flutter run -d linux --debug -t dev/main_debug.dart < /dev/null > /tmp/flutter_run_testbg.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/flutter_bgpid_tmp; echo "launched $(cat /tmp/flutter_bgpid_tmp)"; sleep 1; ls -la /tmp/flutter_run_testbg.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'no log'; ps -p $(cat /tmp/flutter_bgpid_tmp) -o pid,cmd --no-headers 2>/dev/null || echo 'no proc';
